articles.title: OpenAI launches Privacy Filter, an open source, on-device data sanitization model that removes personal information from enterprise datasets
articles.summary: In a significant shift toward local-first privacy infrastructure, OpenAI has released Privacy Filter, a specialized open-source model designed to detect and redact personally identifiable information (PII) before it ever reaches a cloud-based server.
